questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disabled license plates, Disabled Veteran license plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you of construction areas. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for traffic on the other road to pass. You don't need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but you must slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to immediate road conditions. This sign warns of a curve ahead to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to areas where bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop completely before the intersection or stop line. Stay stopped until the arrow turns off.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that roads can cause your car to lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. They show where you can find rest areas, food, hospitals, and other helpful services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to upcoming hazards or special conditions. Orange warning signs indicate construction areas ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At railroad crossings, look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This emblem warns other drivers that the vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower. You may see this on bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, or farm equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: Two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to slow down and prepare for a sharp, sudden change in road direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a traffic law that must be obeyed. You cannot pass other vehicles in this area under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. You must drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic will be merging from the right. Be prepared to allow these vehicles to safely merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic signals are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is beginning ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.
